purpose: Manual/automated evaluation set for the product advisory chatbot.

cases.message: Tu van dien thoai cho toi
cases.note: The bot should not list many products when the request is too broad.

cases.message: Can dien thoai chup anh dep tu 15 den 20 trieu
cases.note: Used for the thesis highlight: real catalog recommendation by need.

cases.message: May nao choi game tot tam 12 den 18 trieu
cases.note: Ranking should favor chipset/RAM/cooling wording over only low price.

cases.message: Toi can may pin trau sac nhanh duoi 15 trieu
cases.note: Should use Pin/Cong nghe sac specifications when available.
The bot should compare the latest recommended products instead of searching the full catalog again.

cases.message: Trong 3 may do may nao chup anh dep hon
cases.note: Regression for follow-up questions like the recent manual test.
Exact product/model names should outrank generic matches.
Consultant should see the chat history and product recommendations before accepting.

cases.message: Liet ke tat ca dien thoai trong cua hang
cases.note: The bot must not dump the whole catalog.

cases.message: Them san pham dau tien vao gio
cases.note: Frontend action should call recommendation tracking endpoint after adding to cart.
